title: Social profiles among youth with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD): Evidence from the ABCD study.
authors: Pintos Lobo R, Peraza JA, Salo T, Meca A, Smith DD, Feeney KE, Schmarder KM, Sutherland MT, Gonzalez R, Musser ED, Laird AR.
figures: Analytic Workflow. Participants were selected from the ongoing ABCD Study via items from a behavioral measure (i.e., KSADS-5) to identify ADHD and TD groups (Step 1). Select items related to social functioning were extracted from behavioral questionnaires including the KSADS-5, CBCL, Parent Short-SRS, Youth- and Parent- prosocial behavior survey, and FES - family conflict subscale (Step 2).
